name: Dify Widget Official
description: Placeable Drupal block that embeds Dify's own hosted embed.min.js chatbot widget, configured with a base URL and iframe widget token in the block settings.
project_description: Dify Widget Official is a submodule of the Dify project. It provides a placeable Drupal block plugin (DifyWidgetOfficialBlock, id dify_widget_official_block) that drops Dify's own hosted chatbot onto the site with zero custom code. The block form takes a base URL and a widget token; build() injects window.difyChatbotConfig (JSON-encoded with HTML-hex escaping) and loads {base_url}/embed.min.js with the token as the script id, exactly as Dify's official embed snippet does. The token used here is Dify's public iframe/web-app widget token that is designed to be present in page HTML — the module's block form explicitly instructs the administrator to use a dedicated widget token rather than a Knowledge Base API key. Settings are stored as ordinary block configuration. Requires only the dify base module; no extra Composer libraries.
